senses.zh: 奇异的；空想的；异想天开的；古怪的；极好的，极出色的；不可思议的；不切实际的

ex.en: We had a fantastic view of the mountains from our balcony.
ex.zh: 从阳台望去，山景美极了。

ex.en: Community sports programmes offer young people a fantastic opportunity to develop teamwork skills and build confidence.
ex.zh: 社区体育项目为年轻人提供了培养团队合作技能和增强自信的绝佳机会。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。表示“极好的”偏口语；正式写作可用excellent。

ex.en: Which jacket should I wear to dinner tonight?
ex.zh: 今晚去吃饭我该穿哪件夹克？

ex.en: Governments must decide which policies will improve air quality without placing excessive financial pressure on households.
ex.zh: 政府必须决定哪些政策能改善空气质量，又不会给家庭造成过大的经济压力。

col: in which case｜如果是那样的话
tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。which常用于限定范围内的选择；what范围更开放。

senses.zh: 清晰地；明显地；无疑地；明净地

ex.en: Please speak clearly so everyone can hear you.
ex.zh: 请说清楚些，让大家都能听清。

ex.en: Public health information should clearly explain the benefits and potential risks of any recommended treatment.
ex.zh: 公共卫生信息应清楚说明任何推荐疗法的益处和潜在风险。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。句首Clearly常表示“显然”，而非“清晰地”。

ex.en: Our team won the match despite the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 尽管下着大雨，我们队还是赢得了比赛。

ex.en: To win public support, governments must explain how environmental policies will benefit communities in the long term.
ex.zh: 为了赢得公众支持，政府必须解释环境政策将如何让社区长期受益。

col: win someone's trust｜赢得某人的信任
tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。过去式和过去分词均为won；赢比赛用win，击败人用beat。

ex.en: Though it was raining, we still walked to the bakery.
ex.zh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是步行去了面包店。

ex.en: Though online courses offer greater flexibility, many students still benefit from direct interaction with teachers.
ex.zh: 虽然线上课程更加灵活，但许多学生仍能从与教师的直接交流中获益。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。引导让步从句时不与but连用；句末可表“不过”。

ex.en: My talented cousin painted this beautiful picture of our garden.
ex.zh: 我那位有绘画天赋的表亲画了这幅漂亮的花园图。

ex.en: Schools should provide opportunities for talented students to develop their abilities beyond the standard curriculum.
ex.zh: 学校应为有才华的学生提供机会，让他们在标准课程之外发展自己的能力。

col: a talented musician｜有天赋的音乐家
a talented artist｜有才华的艺术家
tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。talented强调天赋；skilled强调熟练技能。

ex.en: This is the first place I've felt truly comfortable.
ex.zh: 这是第一个让我感到真正自在的地方。

ex.en: A truly inclusive education system must address the needs of students from different social backgrounds.
ex.zh: 真正包容的教育体系必须满足不同社会背景学生的需求。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。true变truly时去掉e，不能写成truely。

ex.en: My grandmother receives excellent care at the local clinic.
ex.zh: 我奶奶在当地诊所得到很好的照料。

ex.en: Affordable childcare enables more parents to remain employed while ensuring that young children receive appropriate care.
ex.zh: 价格可负担的托育服务让更多家长能够继续工作，同时确保幼儿得到妥善照料。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。care about指在意；care for可指照料或喜欢。
📘 8A Unit 3

ex.en: The baby's funny dance made everyone laugh at dinner.
ex.zh: 宝宝滑稽的舞蹈让吃晚饭的每个人都笑了。

ex.en: People who laugh together regularly may develop stronger social bonds and cope better with everyday stress.
ex.zh: 经常一起欢笑的人可能建立更牢固的社会联系，并更好地应对日常压力。

col: laugh at a joke｜听了笑话发笑
tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。laugh at人常指嘲笑；laugh with人指一起笑。

senses.zh: 严肃的，严重的；认真的；庄重的；危急的

ex.en: The leaking pipe caused serious damage to our kitchen.
ex.zh: 漏水的管道给我们的厨房造成了严重损坏。

ex.en: Air pollution remains a serious threat to public health, especially in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 空气污染仍然严重威胁着公众健康，在人口稠密的城市尤其如此。

col: take something seriously｜认真对待某事
tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。serious about 后接名词或动名词，表示认真对待。

ex.en: He checked his hair in the mirror before leaving.
ex.zh: 他离开前照镜子检查了一下头发。

ex.en: Changes in consumer spending often mirror broader economic trends, particularly during periods of financial uncertainty.
ex.zh: 消费者支出的变化往往反映更广泛的经济趋势，在金融形势不明朗时期尤其如此。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。照镜子用look in the mirror，不用look the mirror。

senses.zh: 小山羊皮制的；较年幼的

ex.en: The kids built a tiny bridge across the stream.
ex.zh: 孩子们在小溪上搭了一座小桥。

ex.en: Outdoor activities can help kids develop social skills while improving their physical health.
ex.zh: 户外活动可以帮助孩子们发展社交技能，同时改善身体健康。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。kid较口语；正式作文中“孩子”宜用child。
📘 8A Unit 3

ex.en: Take a warm coat if you think it's necessary.
ex.zh: 如果你觉得有必要，就带上一件暖和的外套。

ex.en: Investment in public transport is necessary to reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通对于缓解交通拥堵和改善城市空气质量是必要的。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。常用it is necessary to do；necessarily意为“必然地”。
📘 8A Unit 3
📘 8A Unit 3

senses.zh: 年级；等级；成绩；级别；阶段

ex.en: I got a good grade on my science project.
ex.zh: 我的科学课项目得了个好成绩。

ex.en: Teachers should grade assignments consistently so that students understand how their performance is assessed across different subjects.
ex.zh: 教师应按一致的标准给作业评分，让学生了解不同学科如何评估他们的表现。

col: get a good grade｜取得好成绩
tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。表示年级时多用于美式英语；英式英语常用year。

ex.en: You should take an umbrella because it looks cloudy.
ex.zh: 你应该带把伞，因为天看起来阴沉沉的。

ex.en: Governments should invest in affordable public transport to reduce congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 政府应该投资于价格实惠的公共交通，以缓解拥堵并改善城市空气质量。

col: should be able to｜应该能够
tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。情态动词，后接动词原形；should have done常指本该做却未做。
📘 8A Unit 3
📘 8A Unit 3

senses.zh: 范围；延伸；河段；横风行驶

ex.en: We reached the station just before the rain started.
ex.zh: 我们刚到车站，雨就下起来了。

ex.en: Governments must invest in public transport if they hope to reach their targets for reducing urban emissions.
ex.zh: 政府若希望达到减少城市排放的目标，就必须投资公共交通。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。表示到达时直接接地点：reach the station，不加at。

ex.en: She held the warm cup in her left hand.
ex.zh: 她用左手握着温热的杯子。

ex.en: Practical workshops allow students to develop skills by making objects with their own hands.
ex.zh: 实践工作坊让学生通过亲手制作物品来培养技能。

col: give someone a hand｜帮某人一把
hand in an assignment｜提交作业
tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。give someone a hand表示帮忙；by hand表示手工。

ex.en: Please don't touch the pan; it is still hot.
ex.zh: 请别碰锅，它还很烫。

ex.en: Digital communication helps families stay in touch, even when work or study separates them across countries.
ex.zh: 即使工作或学习使家人分居不同国家，数字通信也能帮助他们保持联系。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。保持联系用keep in touch with someone。

senses.zh: 心脏；感情；勇气；心形；要点

ex.en: My heart beats faster when I run uphill.
ex.zh: 我跑上坡时，心跳会加快。

ex.en: Regular physical activity strengthens the heart and can reduce the risk of serious illness.
ex.zh: 经常运动能增强心脏功能，并降低患严重疾病的风险。

col: at the heart of｜处于……的核心
tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。by heart表示熟记；lose heart表示灰心。

ex.en: We checked the facts before booking our train tickets.
ex.zh: 我们核实了相关情况后才订火车票。

ex.en: Students should learn to distinguish facts from opinions when evaluating information shared through digital media.
ex.zh: 学生在评估数字媒体传播的信息时，应学会区分事实和观点。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。the fact that后接完整从句，说明事实内容。
📘 8A Unit 3

senses.zh: （使）破；打破（纪录）；（常指好天气）突变；开始
（嗓音）突变；突破；破晓；（价格）突然下跌
破裂；间断；（持续一段时间的状况的）改变；间歇

ex.en: Be careful not to break that glass bowl.
ex.zh: 小心别打碎那个玻璃碗。

ex.en: Regular breaks during study sessions may improve concentration and help students retain new information.
ex.zh: 学习期间定时休息可能有助于提高注意力，并帮助学生记住新知识。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。动词变化为break—broke—broken；休息用take a break。

senses.zh: 手臂；武器；袖子；装备；部门

ex.en: She carried the sleeping baby gently in her arms.
ex.zh: 她轻轻地把熟睡的宝宝抱在怀里。

ex.en: Schools should arm students with practical skills that help them adapt to a rapidly changing workplace.
ex.zh: 学校应让学生掌握实用技能，帮助他们适应快速变化的职场。

col: arm someone with knowledge｜用知识充实某人
tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。表“武器”用复数arms；arm还可作动词。

ex.en: My sister and I share a desk by the window.
ex.zh: 我和姐姐共用窗边的一张书桌。

ex.en: When residents share responsibility for public spaces, neighbourhoods often become cleaner and more welcoming.
ex.zh: 当居民共同承担公共空间的维护责任时，社区往往会变得更整洁、更宜居。

col: share something with someone｜与某人分享某物
tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。与某人分享用share something with someone。

senses.zh: 大声的，高声的；不断的；喧吵的

ex.en: A loud crash woke everyone in the house.
ex.zh: 一声巨响惊醒了屋里的所有人。

ex.en: Frequent exposure to loud music can damage hearing, particularly among young people who use headphones.
ex.zh: 经常接触高音量的音乐可能损伤听力，使用耳机的年轻人尤其如此。

col: loud and clear｜响亮而清楚地
tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。read out loud指读出声；loudly也可表示大声地。

ex.en: Your jacket looks similar to mine, but slightly darker.
ex.zh: 你的夹克看起来和我的相似，不过颜色稍深一点。

ex.en: Cities with similar population sizes may require different transport policies because of their geographical features.
ex.zh: 人口规模相近的城市可能因地理特征不同而需要不同的交通政策。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。用similar to，不用similar with；相似不等于相同。
📘 8A Unit 3

ex.en: Our primary concern is keeping the children safe.
ex.zh: 我们最关心的是确保孩子们安全。

ex.en: Investment in primary education can reduce inequality by giving children a stronger foundation for future learning.
ex.zh: 投资初等教育可以为儿童今后的学习打下更牢固的基础，从而减少不平等。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。primary school指小学；primarily是副词。

senses.zh: 本村小学；小学教育；小学组

tip: 📘 8A Unit 3

senses.zh: 信息，资料；知识；情报；通知

ex.en: The receptionist gave us useful information about local buses.
ex.zh: 接待员向我们提供了有关当地公交车的实用信息。

ex.en: Access to reliable information enables patients to make better decisions about their treatment and long-term health.
ex.zh: 获取可靠信息能帮助患者就治疗和长期健康作出更好的决定。

col: access to information｜信息获取渠道
a piece of information｜一条信息
tip: 📘 8A Unit 3。不可数：说some information，不说an information。

senses.zh: 傻瓜；女性化的同性恋者；大海鸟

tip: 📘 8A Unit 3

senses.zh: 拌浆锄；小车， 斗底车

tip: 📘 8A Unit 3

senses.zh: 电影院，戏院，剧场；戏剧；手术室

tip: 📘 8A Unit 4

senses.zh: 电影院，戏院；戏剧；阶梯式讲堂

ex.en: We arrived at the theatre just before the play started.
ex.zh: 我们在话剧开演前刚好赶到了剧院。

ex.en: Public funding for theatre can make live performances accessible to audiences who cannot afford expensive tickets.
ex.zh: 对戏剧的公共资助能让买不起高价门票的观众也有机会观看现场演出。

col: go to the theatre｜去剧院看戏
tip: 📘 8A Unit 4。英式拼写theatre，美式常写theater；英式电影院用cinema。

ex.en: This soft chair is comfortable enough for an afternoon nap.
ex.zh: 这把柔软的椅子很舒服，足以让人午睡一会儿。

ex.en: Comfortable classrooms with adequate lighting can help students concentrate and participate more actively in lessons.
ex.zh: 舒适且照明充足的教室有助于学生集中注意力，更积极地参与课堂活动。

col: comfortable with something｜对某事感到自在
tip: 📘 8A Unit 4。comfortable指舒服；convenient指方便。

senses.zh: 使…坐下；可容纳…的；使就职

ex.en: She saved me a seat near the front.
ex.zh: 她在靠前的位置给我留了一个座位。

ex.en: Providing more seats on public transport would make daily travel easier for older passengers and families.
ex.zh: 在公共交通工具上增加座位，会让老年乘客和家庭的日常出行更方便。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 4。sit是不及物动词；seat常接人，be seated表就座。

ex.en: I wiped the fingerprints off my laptop screen.
ex.zh: 我擦掉了笔记本电脑屏幕上的指纹。

ex.en: Health services should screen vulnerable patients regularly to detect diseases before serious symptoms develop.
ex.zh: 医疗服务机构应定期对易患病患者进行筛查，在严重症状出现前发现疾病。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 4。screen A for B表示检查A是否存在B问题。

ex.en: Please close the window before the rain comes in.
ex.zh: 请在雨飘进来之前关上窗户。

ex.en: When local libraries close, residents lose valuable spaces for independent learning and community activities.
ex.zh: 当本地图书馆关闭时，居民就失去了自主学习和开展社区活动的宝贵场所。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 4。动词读/z/；形容词和副词读/s/。

senses.zh: 加标签于；指派；对…开出交通违规罚单

ex.en: I bought a return ticket from the station machine.
ex.zh: 我在车站的售票机上买了一张往返票。

ex.en: Lower ticket prices could encourage more commuters to choose trains instead of driving to work.
ex.zh: 降低票价可以鼓励更多通勤者选择乘火车而非开车上班。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 4。英式single/return ticket分别指单程票和往返票。

senses.zh: 最差的，最坏的；最不利的；效能最低的

ex.en: That was the worst meal I have ever cooked.
ex.zh: 那是我做过的最糟糕的一顿饭。

ex.en: The worst effects of air pollution are often experienced by children and older people in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 在人口密集的城市，儿童和老年人往往受到空气污染最严重的影响。

col: the worst possible outcome｜最坏的可能结果
prepare for the worst｜做最坏的打算
tip: 📘 8A Unit 4。worst是bad和badly的最高级；比较级是worse。
📘 8A Unit 4
📘 8A Unit 4

senses.zh: 流行音乐播音员，流行音乐节目主持人（disc jockey）；地方初审法院法官（District Judge）；司法部（Department of Justice）

tip: 📘 8A Unit 4

ex.en: You can choose a seat beside the window.
ex.zh: 你可以选一个靠窗的座位。

ex.en: Many students choose to study abroad because they want to experience different cultures and teaching methods.
ex.zh: 许多学生选择出国留学，因为他们想体验不同的文化和教学方法。

col: choose to do something｜选择做某事
tip: 📘 8A Unit 4。过去式chose，过去分词chosen；后接to do。
📘 8A Unit 4

ex.en: A reporter interviewed the coach after the match.
ex.zh: 比赛结束后，一名记者采访了教练。

ex.en: A responsible reporter checks information carefully before publishing stories that could influence public opinion on important social issues.
ex.zh: 负责任的记者在发表可能影响公众对重要社会问题看法的报道之前，会仔细核实信息。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 4。reporter侧重新闻采访报道；journalist涵盖范围更广。

senses.zh: 就是那么些；到现在为止；到目前(此地)为止；就此范围来说
到目前为止；迄今为止；至今

tip: 📘 8A Unit 4

senses.zh: 新鲜的；清新的；淡水的；无经验的

ex.en: I bought fresh strawberries from the market this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我在市场买了新鲜草莓。

ex.en: Access to fresh fruit and vegetables is essential for improving diets in low-income urban communities.
ex.zh: 让城市低收入社区居民能获得新鲜果蔬，对改善其饮食至关重要。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 4。fresh water指淡水；fresh air指新鲜空气。
📘 8A Unit 4

senses.zh: 更坏的；更差的；更恶劣的（bad的比较级）；（病情）更重的（ill的比较级）
更糟；更坏；更恶劣地；更坏地

ex.en: The weather grew worse as we climbed the hill.
ex.zh: 我们爬山时，天气变得更糟了。

ex.en: Traffic congestion may become worse unless cities invest in reliable and affordable public transport.
ex.zh: 除非城市投资建设可靠且价格合理的公共交通，否则交通拥堵可能进一步恶化。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 4。bad和badly的比较级；最高级是worst。

senses.zh: 服务性的；耐用的；服现役的

ex.en: The friendly service made us feel welcome at the café.
ex.zh: 咖啡馆里热情的服务让我们感到宾至如归。

ex.en: Reliable bus services allow residents without cars to reach hospitals, schools and workplaces.
ex.zh: 可靠的公交服务让没有汽车的居民也能到达医院、学校和工作地点。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 4。表示服务质量常不可数；各项服务可用复数。

senses.zh: 有吸引力的事物（尤指饰品）；漂亮的人

ex.en: We found a pretty cottage beside a quiet stream.
ex.zh: 我们在一条安静的小溪边发现了一座漂亮的小屋。

ex.en: Although pretty public gardens attract visitors, cities must also ensure that these spaces remain accessible to residents.
ex.zh: 虽然漂亮的公共花园能吸引游客，但城市也必须确保居民能方便地使用这些空间。

col: a pretty dress｜漂亮的连衣裙
tip: 📘 8A Unit 4。作副词表示“相当”时偏口语，正式写作可用fairly。

ex.en: There are several vegetarian dishes on the menu.
ex.zh: 菜单上有几道素菜。

ex.en: Displaying nutritional information on a restaurant menu may help customers make healthier choices when eating out.
ex.zh: 在餐厅菜单上标注营养信息，可能有助于顾客外出就餐时做出更健康的选择。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 4。说菜品在菜单上，用on the menu，不用in。

senses.zh: 行为，行动；法令，法案；（戏剧，歌剧的）一幕，段；装腔作势
行动；扮演，充当；表现，举止；假装，演戏；起作用，见效

ex.en: We must act quickly before the kitchen sink overflows.
ex.zh: 我们必须赶快采取行动，免得厨房水槽里的水溢出来。

ex.en: Governments need to act decisively to reduce air pollution and protect the health of urban residents.
ex.zh: 政府需要果断采取行动，减少空气污染，保护城市居民的健康。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 4。act as表示充当；act还可指戏剧的一幕。

ex.en: Dad cooked a warm meal after our long walk.
ex.zh: 我们长途步行回来后，爸爸做了一顿热乎乎的饭。

ex.en: Providing healthy school meals can improve children's concentration and support their physical development.
ex.zh: 提供健康的学校餐食能提高儿童的专注力，并促进他们的身体发育。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 4。meal指一顿饭；food泛指食物，通常不可数。

ex.en: My creative sister turned old jars into colourful lamps.
ex.zh: 我富有创意的姐姐把旧罐子变成了彩色灯具。

ex.en: Schools should encourage creative thinking by allowing students to explore several solutions to the same problem.
ex.zh: 学校应允许学生探索同一问题的多种解决方案，以鼓励创造性思维。

col: a creative solution｜创新的解决方案
tip: 📘 8A Unit 4。形容人有创意或方法新颖；名词形式是creativity。

ex.en: A street performer juggled oranges beside the crowded market.
ex.zh: 一名街头艺人在拥挤的市场旁抛接橙子。

ex.en: Public funding can help young performers develop their skills and bring live entertainment to underserved communities.
ex.zh: 公共资金可以帮助年轻表演者提升技能，并将现场演出带到文化服务不足的社区。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 4。不仅指演员；top performer也可指业绩优异的员工。

ex.en: My cousin has a real talent for drawing animals.
ex.zh: 我的表亲画动物很有天赋。

ex.en: Schools should nurture creative talent alongside academic skills to help students develop a wider range of abilities.
ex.zh: 学校应在培养学业技能的同时培育创造性才能，帮助学生发展更广泛的能力。

col: a talent for｜在某方面的天赋
tip: 📘 8A Unit 4。表示某方面的天赋，用a talent for加名词或动名词。

senses.zh: 没有共同之处；有某些共同之处
共同点；与…有共通之处；有共同点

tip: 📘 8A Unit 4

ex.en: The magician pulled a silk scarf from an empty cup.
ex.zh: 魔术师从空杯子里抽出了一条丝巾。

ex.en: A skilled magician can demonstrate how easily human attention is directed away from important visual details.
ex.zh: 技艺娴熟的魔术师可以展示，人的注意力多么容易被引开，从而忽略重要的视觉细节。

col: skilled magician｜技艺娴熟的魔术师
tip: 📘 8A Unit 4。现实中指魔术表演者；故事中也可指魔法师。

senses.zh: 各种各样的；表示各种各样的；各种各类的

tip: 📘 8A Unit 4
📘 8A Unit 4
📘 8A Unit 4

ex.en: My role is to welcome guests at the door.
ex.zh: 我的职责是在门口迎接客人。

ex.en: Public libraries play an important role in providing equal access to information and educational resources.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆在提供平等获取信息和教育资源的机会方面发挥着重要作用。

col: play a role in｜在……中起作用
take on a role｜承担职责
tip: 📘 8A Unit 4。表示“在……中起作用”用play a role in。

senses.zh: 扮演角色；起作用；发挥作用

tip: 📘 8A Unit 4

ex.en: The winner lifted her trophy as the crowd cheered.
ex.zh: 获胜者举起奖杯，人群欢呼起来。

ex.en: Consumers may be the main winners when greater competition encourages companies to lower prices and improve services.
ex.zh: 当更激烈的竞争促使企业降价并改善服务时，消费者可能成为主要受益者。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 4。winner 指获胜者；winning 可作形容词修饰队伍。

ex.en: Lina won a prize for her colourful garden.
ex.zh: 莉娜因她色彩缤纷的花园获了奖。

ex.en: Offering a prize for innovative designs can encourage students to develop practical solutions to environmental problems.
ex.zh: 为创新设计设奖，可以鼓励学生提出解决环境问题的实用方案。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 4。prize可作动词表珍视，常见be highly prized。

ex.en: Everybody is waiting outside for the doors to open.
ex.zh: 所有人都在外面等着开门。

ex.en: Public libraries should offer accessible services so that everybody can benefit from opportunities for lifelong learning.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆应提供无障碍服务，让每个人都能受益于终身学习的机会。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 4。作主语时谓语用单数：Everybody is ready。
📘 8A Unit 4

senses.zh: 作为…的例子；为…做出榜样

ex.en: Could you give me an example of a healthy breakfast?
ex.zh: 你能给我举一个健康早餐的例子吗？

ex.en: Public buildings can set an example by using renewable energy and reducing unnecessary water consumption.
ex.zh: 公共建筑可以通过使用可再生能源和减少不必要的用水来树立榜样。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 4。for example用于举例；set an example意为树立榜样。
📘 8A Unit 4

senses.zh: 贫穷的；可怜的；贫乏的；卑鄙的

ex.en: The poor family could barely afford fresh vegetables.
ex.zh: 这户贫困家庭几乎买不起新鲜蔬菜。

ex.en: Poor public transport can limit employment opportunities for people living far from major urban centres.
ex.zh: 公共交通不便可能限制远离主要城市中心的居民的就业机会。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 4。poor at表示不擅长；poor in表示缺乏。
📘 8A Unit 4

senses.zh: 认真对待；认真看待；高度重视

tip: 📘 8A Unit 4

senses.zh: 捐赠；面向；有弹性；气候转暖

ex.en: Please give your sister a clean towel after swimming.
ex.zh: 游泳后请给你妹妹一条干净的毛巾。

ex.en: Schools should give students opportunities to develop practical skills through projects that address real community needs.
ex.zh: 学校应通过解决社区实际需求的项目，让学生有机会培养实践技能。

col: give someone a chance｜给某人机会
tip: 📘 8A Unit 4。give sb sth＝give sth to sb；过去式gave。

ex.en: The bus was so crowded that we stood all the way.
ex.zh: 公交车太拥挤了，我们一路都站着。

ex.en: Crowded urban neighbourhoods need accessible parks where residents can exercise and enjoy some personal space.
ex.zh: 拥挤的城市社区需要方便到达的公园，让居民能够锻炼并享有一些个人空间。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 4。be crowded with 表示“挤满……”。

senses.zh: 手（尤用于与幼儿说话时）；侦察用车

tip: 📘 8A Unit 4

senses.zh: 美国偶像；美国偶像大赛；美国偶像最终决赛

tip: 📘 8A Unit 4
📘 8A Unit 5

senses.zh: 情境喜剧；最佳情景喜剧；处境喜剧

tip: 📘 8A Unit 5

ex.en: She called her sister to share the good news.
ex.zh: 她给姐姐打电话，分享这个好消息。

ex.en: People should check several reliable sources before sharing news about health issues on social media.
ex.zh: 人们在社交媒体上分享健康问题的新闻前，应核实多个可靠来源。

col: a piece of news｜一条消息
tip: 📘 8A Unit 5。news不可数且接单数谓语：The news is good。

senses.zh: 将肥皂涂在……上；对……拍马屁（俚语）

ex.en: Please wash your hands with soap before lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭前请用肥皂洗手。

ex.en: Providing clean water and soap in schools can help prevent infections and improve children's overall health.
ex.zh: 在学校提供清洁用水和肥皂有助于预防感染，改善儿童的整体健康状况。

col: a bar of soap｜一块肥皂
tip: 📘 8A Unit 5。指清洁用品通常不可数；一块用a bar of soap。

ex.en: Please stand near the door until the bus stops.
ex.zh: 请站在车门附近，等公交车停稳。

ex.en: Local residents took a stand against the proposed road because it would destroy valuable woodland.
ex.zh: 当地居民坚决反对这条拟建道路，因为它会破坏珍贵的林地。

col: can't stand doing something｜无法忍受做某事
take a stand｜表明坚定立场
tip: 📘 8A Unit 5。过去式和过去分词均为stood；忍受常用can't stand。
📘 8A Unit 5

ex.en: Our plan is to leave early and avoid traffic.
ex.zh: 我们的计划是早点出发，避开拥堵。

ex.en: Cities need a clear plan for expanding public transport before introducing restrictions on private vehicles.
ex.zh: 城市在实施私家车限制措施之前，需要制定明确的公共交通扩展计划。

col: plan to do something｜计划做某事
tip: 📘 8A Unit 5。plan to do表示打算做；过去式planned双写n。

ex.en: I hope the rain stops before our picnic.
ex.zh: 我希望野餐前雨能停。

ex.en: Many graduates hope to find meaningful employment that allows them to contribute positively to society.
ex.zh: 许多毕业生希望找到有意义的工作，使自己能够为社会作出积极贡献。

col: hope to do something｜希望做某事
hope for the best｜抱最好的希望
in the hope of｜怀着……的希望
tip: 📘 8A Unit 5。可说hope to do，不说hope sb to do。

senses.zh: 查出；发现；看清…的面目；识破

tip: 📘 8A Unit 5

ex.en: We had a lively discussion about our holiday plans.
ex.zh: 我们热烈讨论了度假计划。

ex.en: Public discussion of transport policy can help governments design services that better meet residents' needs.
ex.zh: 对交通政策的公开讨论可以帮助政府设计更符合居民需求的服务。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 5。名词可接about或of；动词discuss后直接接话题。

ex.en: What happened to the plant beside your window?
ex.zh: 你窗边那盆植物怎么了？

ex.en: Traffic accidents are more likely to happen when drivers are tired or distracted by mobile phones.
ex.zh: 驾驶员疲劳或因手机分心时，更容易发生交通事故。

col: happen to someone｜发生在某人身上
happen to do something｜碰巧做某事
tip: 📘 8A Unit 5。不用于被动语态；happen to do表示碰巧做某事。

ex.en: We expect rain, so take an umbrella with you.
ex.zh: 我们预计会下雨，所以带上雨伞吧。

ex.en: Employers increasingly expect graduates to demonstrate practical skills as well as a strong understanding of their subject.
ex.zh: 雇主越来越期望毕业生既展现实践技能，又具备扎实的专业知识。

col: expect to do something｜预计做某事
expect someone to do something｜期望某人做某事
tip: 📘 8A Unit 5。expect偏重认为会发生，hope偏重希望发生。

ex.en: My brother told a joke that made everyone laugh.
ex.zh: 我哥哥讲了个笑话，把大家都逗笑了。

ex.en: Teachers sometimes use jokes to reduce anxiety and create a more relaxed classroom atmosphere.
ex.zh: 教师有时会用笑话缓解焦虑，营造更轻松的课堂氛围。

col: play a joke on someone｜捉弄某人
joke about something｜拿某事开玩笑
tip: 📘 8A Unit 5。讲笑话用tell a joke，不用say a joke。

senses.zh: 喜剧；喜剧性；有趣的事情

ex.en: We watched a comedy and laughed all evening.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部喜剧，整个晚上都笑个不停。

ex.en: Comedy can encourage audiences to question social attitudes by presenting familiar problems in unexpected and amusing ways.
ex.zh: 喜剧可以用出人意料又有趣的方式呈现常见问题，促使观众反思社会观念。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 5。指喜剧类型时通常不可数；一部喜剧用a comedy。
📘 8A Unit 5

senses.zh: 行动；活动；功能；战斗；情节

ex.en: We need to take action before the leak worsens.
ex.zh: 我们得在漏水加重之前采取行动。

ex.en: Governments must take urgent action to protect coastal communities from the growing risks of climate change.
ex.zh: 政府必须紧急采取行动，保护沿海社区免受日益加剧的气候变化风险影响。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 5。take action中的action不可数；具体举动可用actions。
